lines.text: Capricorn, they don't want a calendar invite. They want you, unplanned.
lines.caption: cancel the invite

lines.text: Capricorn, the work will still be there. Will you?
lines.caption: will you though

lines.text: Capricorn, love is not a project you can manage to completion.
lines.caption: not a project

lines.text: Capricorn, rest is not something you earn. It is something you need.
lines.caption: rest is not a reward

lines.text: Capricorn, saying I'm fine is a door you keep locking from the inside.
lines.caption: unlock it

lines.text: Capricorn, the summit is lonely if you climbed it to avoid the valley.
lines.caption: the valley is waiting

lines.text: Capricorn, the office will not hold you when you cry.
lines.caption: log off tonight

lines.text: Capricorn, busy is not the same as safe.
lines.caption: busy is not safe

lines.text: Capricorn, someone wants to know you, not your five-year plan.
lines.caption: not the plan, you

lines.text: Capricorn, fine is the word you use when the real word is too heavy.
lines.caption: what's the real word

lines.text: Capricorn, being the one who holds everything together is not the same as being held.
lines.caption: let someone hold you

lines.text: Capricorn, your worth was never a number on a spreadsheet.
lines.caption: close the spreadsheet

lines.text: Capricorn, they asked how you are. Fine is not a feeling.
lines.caption: fine is not a feeling

lines.text: Capricorn, the plan can change and you will still be you.
lines.caption: let it change

lines.text: Capricorn, love can't be earned by being the most useful one in the room.
lines.caption: you don't have to earn it

lines.text: Capricorn, control feels like calm until something real happens.
lines.caption: loosen the grip

lines.text: Capricorn, staying late at work is also a way of leaving.
lines.caption: come home

lines.text: Capricorn, a day off is not a crime against your future.
lines.caption: take the day

lines.text: Capricorn, letting them help is not losing control. It's letting them in.
lines.caption: let them help

lines.text: Capricorn, nobody is grading the way you spend a Sunday.
lines.caption: no grades on sunday

lines.text: Capricorn, the wall you built for safety is also where they stopped trying.
lines.caption: the wall works both ways

lines.text: Capricorn, ambition is a good engine. It is a bad steering wheel.
lines.caption: who is driving

lines.text: Capricorn, romance does not need a business case.
lines.caption: no slides needed

lines.text: Capricorn, the inbox is a place to hide that looks like a place to work.
lines.caption: hiding in the inbox

lines.text: Capricorn, they noticed you went quiet. They're waiting for you to notice too.
lines.caption: they noticed

lines.text: Capricorn, the child who grew up too fast deserves one slow afternoon.
lines.caption: one slow afternoon

lines.text: Capricorn, a text back costs less than the meeting you're in.
lines.caption: text them back

lines.text: Capricorn, success with no one to tell is just a quiet room.
lines.caption: call someone

lines.text: Capricorn, the right person is not a merger. Stop vetting and start feeling.
lines.caption: stop vetting

lines.text: Capricorn, the pattern breaks when you log off before you're finished.
lines.caption: break the loop

lines.text: Capricorn, someone soft can still be serious about you.
lines.caption: soft and serious

lines.text: Capricorn, what would you do today if nothing had to be productive?
lines.caption: do nothing on purpose

lines.text: Capricorn, being impressive was never the requirement for being chosen.
lines.caption: you were already chosen

lines.text: Capricorn, being the responsible one is a role, not a personality.
lines.caption: put the role down

lines.text: Capricorn, love scheduled in fifteen-minute blocks will feel like fifteen minutes.
lines.caption: unblock the calendar

lines.text: Capricorn, the goalpost moved again. Did you notice who moved it?
lines.caption: it was you

lines.text: Capricorn, control the budget, not the person.
lines.caption: just the budget

lines.text: Capricorn, slow progress is still progress. You know this. Believe it.
lines.caption: slow still counts

lines.text: Capricorn, nobody puts vulnerability in the quarterly report. Say it anyway.
lines.caption: say it anyway

lines.text: Capricorn, feelings don't go away when you file them for later.
lines.caption: later is now

lines.text: Capricorn, they don't need it all figured out. They need you there.
lines.caption: just be there

lines.text: Capricorn, the people you're still proving yourself to left the room years ago.
lines.caption: they already left

lines.text: Capricorn, waiting for the perfect time to love someone is how time runs out.
lines.caption: there is no perfect time

lines.text: Capricorn, burnout is not a badge. It is a bill.
lines.caption: the bill comes due

lines.text: Capricorn, your silence reads as distance, even when it's devotion.
lines.caption: say it out loud

lines.text: Capricorn, the mountain will wait while you eat lunch.
lines.caption: eat the lunch

lines.text: Capricorn, say the soft thing out loud. It won't cost you the mountain.
lines.caption: the soft thing

lines.text: Capricorn, discipline that never pauses is just another kind of fear.
lines.caption: pause on purpose

lines.text: Capricorn, what if being held is the goal, not the reward?
lines.caption: what if

lines.text: Capricorn, the five-year plan has no line for joy. Add one.
lines.caption: add a line for joy

lines.text: Capricorn, the ex who called you cold may have just wanted a door.
lines.caption: they wanted a door

lines.text: Capricorn, hard work got you here. Softness will get you further.
lines.caption: try softness

lines.text: Capricorn, partners are not employees. Stop giving performance reviews.
lines.caption: no reviews tonight

lines.text: Capricorn, the version of you who fails is still worth knowing.
lines.caption: meet that version

lines.text: Capricorn, the strongest thing you can say might be I miss you.
lines.caption: i miss you works

lines.text: Capricorn, money buys the quiet. It can't buy the peace inside it.
lines.caption: quiet is not peace

lines.text: Capricorn, love doesn't arrive after the promotion. It is happening now.
lines.caption: it is happening now

lines.text: Capricorn, there is no prize for suffering the longest.
lines.caption: no prize for this

lines.text: Capricorn, they stayed through your busy season. Stay through their quiet one.
lines.caption: stay through it

lines.text: Capricorn, being fine every single day is its own kind of alarm.
lines.caption: the alarm is fine
